describe.manifest.ts: the `ShardManifest`, default-exported. Node-safe: data and lazy thunks only
describe.README.md: what the shard declares, its custom code and why, budgets, look, open work (its plan rows)
describe.budgets.ts: the budget inputs (§9); or `data/budgets.ts` as pure data (`dataHomes`)
describe.ktx2.generated.ts: your KTX2 table, written by `bake-ktx2` once you bake KTX2 art. The one generated file you commit
describe.budgetCeilings.ts: recorded F2 ceilings (the four existing shards only); `data/budgetCeilings.ts` beside `data/budgets.ts`
describe.layout.ts: every coordinate: sites, trails, spawn points
describe.audio/: the cue map, ambience, score wiring
describe.world/: world building: pieces, terrain dressing, water, climate
describe.design/: the shard's design pack: `design.md` and `spec.json` (optional; E406)
describe.generators/: build-time code that makes assets (models, terrain, scatter): run by the bake, never imported by the shard's runtime and never shipped (SHARD-PLATFORM SP5; optional)
describe.data/: the shard's content rows and layouts as serialisable values (JSON-able, no functions, no three.js or DOM): `sim-no-render` and the row ratchet hold it (SHARD-PLATFORM SP5; optional)
describe.runtime/: the shard's own runtime code that no approved system covers yet: the custom share the 80/20 split counts (SHARD-PLATFORM SP5; optional)
describe.shard.config.ts: the SDK project source that builds shard.json (SHARD-PLATFORM SF7b)
describe.quests/: serialisable quest graphs and dialogue trees
describe.assets/: source assets consumed by the build
